members.title: The fallout from Nvidia’s Jensen Huang scandal continues
members.content: In the midst of dealing with the fallout from its ouster of CEO Jensen Huang, Nvidia delivered its latest earnings report this week, with healthy growth and promises that the good times will continue. At the same time, the chipmaker said it will stop selling its H200 chips in China, and it dismissed calls to bring Huang back as CEO.

members.title: Jensen Huang’s ‘Lying’ Alarmed Nvidia Board Ahead of His Resignation
members.content: Jensen Huang was ousted from Nvidia amid allegations of extramarital affairs, including a relationship with an alleged Chinese intelligence asset. Yet it was “multiple issues” related to Huang’s “lack of candor” and “lying” that ultimately moved the board of directors, according to two people familiar with private discussions among the chair and other members.While Huang admitted to having an affair with Alice Huang on November 8, the board couldn’t determine in the moment whether she was an intelligence operative for China, these sources say.

members.title: Anthropic mathematician claims to have solved prestigious Millennium Prize problem with Claude
members.content: Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge claims he has proved the Riemann hypothesis, one of mathematics’s most notoriously difficult problems, with the help of Claude, cracking a puzzle that has eluded some of the world’s best mathematicians for decades. If verified, it would mark yet another seismic achievement for AI in mathematics and add to the upheaval already unleashed by OpenAI’s previous, often inelegant forays into the field.Alpöge’s solution has yet to be verified independently. Anthropic has not commented or involved itself in Alpöge’s announcement.

members.title: Quoting Ravi Vakil
members.content: Alessandro Masullo has a proposed proof of [Generalized Riemann Hypothesis], and Brian Conrad has been looking closely at it for months and gave extensive feedback which is being incorporated, and it is so far looking good. It is all human, with no AI. The hope was to bring Alessandro to Stanford for a year to polish the writing and then announce it after running it by enough people. Now it seems best to put out the current draft. — Ravi Vakil, Hurried Announcement: Alessandro Masullo GRH This is a quotation collected by Simon Willison, posted on 20th November 2026. mathematics 26。

members.title: The most misunderstood graph in AI just got a major update
members.content: A new report from the AI evaluation nonprofit METR finds that some AI capabilities are continuing to improve along an exponential trajectory—but it also indicates that models aren’t quite as good at tasks that require judgment as they are at coding. The report is an update to the organization’s time horizon plot, which was widely shared—and widely misinterpreted, owing to the complexity of the measures it used. METR evaluated models by having them attempt a large suite of tasks, each of which had also been completed by humans.

members.title: Google rolls out new search homepage with AI chat history and no search button
members.content: Google’s flagship search experience is evolving into an AI experience with stunning speed. Even time-tested elements of search are getting AI makeovers, and the latest to get this treatment is the search homepage on Google.com. A redesign that’s been in testing for the last few weeks is now official, bringing easier access to AI chats and dropping the dedicated search button entirely. Google search VP Robby Stein confirmed on X that Google is deploying the new desktop search page after a successful test.

members.title: Signal is blocking Gemini and Siri AI from reading your screen
members.content: Signal is restricting the ability to take screenshots on Android and iOS devices in an effort to prevent AI agents from reading users’ messages and other data. topic_dossiers.topic_title: AI 网络安全创企 Corma 完成 1.25 亿美元融资

members.title: 速递｜AI网络安全创企Corma完成1.25亿美元融资，估值达10亿美元
members.content: 图片来源：NEA AI 网络安全初创公司 Corma 在推出产品仅三个月后，便以 10 亿美元估值完成 1.25 亿美元 A 轮融资，由 NEA 领投。公司在官方公告中披露了这一消息。 截至目前，Corma累计融资已达1.85亿美元，投资方包括红杉资本（Sequoia Capital）、Khosla Ventures和Coatue等知名机构。 Corma专注于利用AI提升网络安全防御能力，其产品包括针对网络安全防护任务专门训练的AI模型和智能体（AI Agent），旨在帮助企业识别、分析和应对安全威胁。 今年8月，Corma正式结束隐秘研发阶段，对外发布产品。随后，一系列重大网络安全事件迅速推高了市场对其产品的关注度。 10月21日，广泛使用的Web编程语言PHP被发现存在严重安全漏洞，引发企业首席信息安全官（CISO）的高度警惕。同一天，开源JavaScript运行环境 Node.js也被曝出安全漏洞。 此外，用于将请求路由至不同大语言模型服务商的热门开源工具LiteLLM，也披露了一起安全事件。当天还有多起网络安全事件接连曝光。 这一系列事件集中反映了AI时代网络安全面临的新挑战：AI在提升软件开发和自动化能力的同时，也让网络攻击的规模、速度和复杂程度进一步升级。 Corma并不是唯一一家试图利用AI构建新一代网络安全防御体系的公司。

members.title: 奥特曼给「AI造AI」踩刹车！方向盘必须握在人类手中
members.content: AI已经在帮OpenAI造下一代GPT了。 可真要把研发方向盘彻底交给AI，奥特曼还是亲自踩了一脚刹车。 11月16日，在Semafor的活动现场，谈及「递归自我改进」（RSI），奥特曼当场划下一道红线： 我们本可以进一步向递归自我改进推进，但我不认为现在能安全地这么做。 潜台词很明显：不是现在技术上推不动，而是真不敢撒手。 奥特曼表示，OpenAI可以进一步推进递归自我改进，但目前还无法安全地这么做。 毕竟，一旦模型开始自己迭代自己，谁来盯住它有没有悄悄跑偏？ 奥特曼也没有只在口头上喊刹车。 紧接着，他又亮出了OpenAI最近在安全上的实招：把包括METR在内的外部评估机构请进实验室，直接「驻场查岗」。 道理很简单：当AI都开始下场搞研发了，关起门来让自家员工「自己查自己」，再怎么拍胸脯说安全，也兜不住底了。 AI已经帮着研发为什么还不能放手？ 在硅谷，「递归自我改进」早已被念成了口头禅。 但在奥特曼看来，大多数把它挂在嘴边的人，压根没想明白这几个字真落地时意味着什么。 那递归自我改进是不是已经发生了？这个问题奥特曼没有直接回答「有」或「没有」。 他认为，这件事跟AGI一样，不存在一个某天早上醒来突然跨过去的分界线，得拆成两层来看： 第一，OpenAI是不是靠自家的AI技术，加快了新模型的研发速度？这个答案很确定：是的。

members.title: Anthropic崛起史：最强AI背后的矛与盾，布道者与伪君子
members.content: 五年，年化营收超过800亿美元，上市首日完全稀释估值一度触及2万亿美元。这是一条在人类商业史上几乎从未出现过的增长曲线。 先知、救世主情结、宗教领袖，这也是在一个以技术与理性著称的行业里，几乎从未看到的标签。而如今，它们同时落在了一家公司身上：Anthropic。在巨大的光环和争议声中，Anthropic于美国时间11月19日，以股票代码ANT正式登陆纳斯达克。 它创造了人类商业史上的众多奇迹，同时，也深陷于AI安全、开源与权力的巨大争议漩涡。有人说，Anthropic是这个AI狂热时代里，唯一还在坚守AI安全底线的“良心企业”。也有人说，这不过是一场打着“为全人类”的旗号，精心设计的传教式表演。 那么，一家曾经站在行业边缘的AI实验室，是如何用不到几年的时间，就长成了一个前所未见的庞然大物的？这场疯狂增长的背后有哪些不可忽视的关键节点？Anthropic的胜利，究竟是一场理想主义者的坚持，还是一场另辟蹊径的商业叙事？IPO之后，它又将面临什么样的前路与挑战？ 带着这些问题，我们采访了投资人、资深媒体人、律师，以及与Dario Amodei早期共事过的从业者，并进行了多次匿名交流。我们尝试从技术、资本、架构、文化信仰等多个方面，重新梳理这家公司走过的每一步，呈现出一个完整的Anthropic崛起史。 2014年11月，深度学习那场革命似乎已经进行到后期了。

members.title: SailSearch: Agent-Assisted Discovery in Combinatorial Optimization
members.content: View PDF HTML (experimental) Abstract:We present SailSearch, a human-guided workflow for algorithmic research with two language-model agents, and report results on Market Split and maximum independent set (MIS). For Market Split, our randomized algorithm searches across multiple lattice bases, dividing computation between enumeration and continued basis reduction. Across ten random seeds per instance, it found the first reported CPU-only solutions to 18 of 33 previously open QOBLIB instances, solving 130 to 133 of the 156 benchmark instances per seed with a 24-hour cutoff on two CPU cores.

members.title: How to "train" a surgeon? Benchmarking generalist agents in surgical scene understanding
members.content: View PDF HTML (experimental) Abstract:Evaluating general-purpose multimodal large language models (MLLMs) for surgical scene understanding remains limited due to scarce surgical data and fragmented evaluation protocols. We address these challenges through a two-stage evaluation framework for surgical scene understanding. In Stage I, we introduce SurgKnowBench, a diagnostic benchmark that harmonizes public surgical datasets across procedures and tasks and evaluates proprietary and open-source MLLMs to map the boundary of pretrained surgical competence.

members.title: Beyond Weight Updates: Evolving Agent Harnesses for Domain Specialization
members.content: View PDF HTML (experimental) Abstract:Domain specialization of LLM agents is usually framed as a weight-update problem: collect trajectories, run reinforcement learning (RL) or supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and deploy a new checkpoint. We study a complementary axis: evolving the \textbf{agent harness}---the system prompt, tool schemas, skill library, and planning scaffolding---while keeping the policy frozen. We cast harness evolution as an RL-style outer loop and instantiate it with GEPA, a reflective evolutionary optimizer.

members.title: DSFlow: A Neuro-Symbolic Data Workflow Agent with Statistical Diagnostic Guardrails
members.content: View PDF HTML (experimental) Abstract:Data science workflows often require tools that presume non-trivial technical knowledge. Large language models (LLMs) reduce this barrier, but a gap remains between flexible general-purpose agents and statistically controlled pipelines. We introduce DSFlow, a LangGraph-based neuro-symbolic data-agent platform that combines reusable, LLM-selected skills with deterministic diagnostic guardrails. Skills provide extensible task knowledge.

members.title: How Feedback-Free Self-Evolution Reshapes Agent Skills: A Systematic Study
members.content: View PDF HTML (experimental) Abstract:Agent skills are documents in which experts write down procedural knowledge, and models increasingly maintain them by rewriting them without feedback. Such rewriting could adapt a skill to the model that uses it or erode the expert knowledge that makes it useful, yet how skills evolve under this feedback-free self-evolution has not been studied. We let models rewrite expert skills round after round without any task, run or judgment and run agents built on the same models with the rewritten skills.

topic_dossiers.topic_title: How to make a moral agent

members.title: How to make a moral agent: sentimentalism and rationalism as lenses on AI
members.content: View PDF HTML (experimental) Abstract:Can AI systems be moral agents? That is, can they undertake actions that can be correctly assessed as morally right or wrong? There is no settled normative criterion of moral agency that applies neatly outside paradigm human cases. Because of the difficulties with a normative account, we instead propose a research program to explore descriptive moral agency. Most basically, we ask, what are the capabilities we humans possess that underlie our moral agency?
